1. (Currently amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __that is distinct from data bits in said send packet__ and triggering an event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit __wherein said event is triggered by a state change of said trigger bit__.

2. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __initiating__ waveform digitization __of an input signal at a module__.

3. (Original) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises waveform synthesis.

4. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and wherein said receive packet is transmitted asynchronously with respect to said send packet__.

5. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement __wherein said results are captured at a time determined by said trigger bit__.

11. (Currently amended) An apparatus for performing synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules comprising a housing comprising a controller and receiving two or more modules, a respective serial communications link between said controller and each of said two or more modules, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, means for transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __that is distinct from data bits in said send packet__, and means in each said module for triggering a module specific event upon receipt of respective ones of said trigger bits __wherein said event is triggered by a state change of said trigger bit__.

12. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __initiating__ waveform digitization __of an input signal at a module__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __initiating__ waveform digitization __of an input signal__ and waveform synthesis __of an output signal__ on separate channels of said module.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising means for receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and wherein said receive packet is transmitted asynchronously with respect to said send packet__.

15. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 14 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement __wherein said results are captured at a time determined by said trigger bit__.

16. (Original) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform synthesis.
